question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Cacophony
solution: The correct answer is option 3), i.e., 'Symphony.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's look at the meaning of the given word: • **Cacophony** - a harsh, unpleasant mixture of sounds. (शोर-शराबा) • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:​ • **Colophony** - a type of resin obtained from pine trees. (पाइन के पेड़ों से प्राप्त राल) • **Polyphony** - music that consists of two or more simultaneous melodies. (बहुस्वर) • **Symphony** - an elaborate musical composition for a full orchestra; a harmonious combination of sounds. (स्वर की समता, वाद्य-वृंद रचना) • **Antiphony** - the alternation of singing by two choirs. (दो टोलियों द्वारा गाना) • Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Cacophony' and 'Symphony' are antonyms. • So, the correct answer is option 3. 3a:Tace4,
